rideOn.name: Biel/Bienne, Bahnhof/Gare
rideOn.note: Recorded bus 9 takes two minutes from Place Guisan and the following station walk is five minutes. Other lines have different ride times; matching uses the actual feeder pass list.

validity.note: Desk review expires at the December 2026 timetable change; this is a review deadline, not an announced closure.

fieldCheckNeeded: Walk each supported boarding-quay approach and confirm current signs, crossings and public entrance availability.
Measure actual stair rise; step counts are mapped, while 0.18 m per riser is an explicit conservative timing assumption.
Measure door approach by train length and stopping sector; current typical/maximum 100/300 m values are model allowances.
Time a representative peak-period transfer; short-notice closures and pedestrian queues are not available from the connection API.
instructions: From Place Guisan, follow the public pavement towards Bahnhofplatz / Place de la Gare. Use the marked pedestrian crossings, enter the central station underpass, and take the signed stairs up to your platform.
